text: ぼくも　じてんしゃ　もってたら　サイクリング　ロード　いきたーい！

structure.jp: ぼくも　じてんしゃ　もってたら
structure.en: if I had a Bicycle too

structure.jp: サイクリング　ロード　いきたーい！
structure.en: I'd want to go to Cycling Road!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if'. もってたら is the short spoken form of もっていたら. じてんしゃ もってたら = 'if I had a Bicycle'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to'. The sound is stretched out here to show longing. いきたーい = 'I sooo want to go'.
